fix.item: ⁠The update records of your Joomanji products are checked on install: a product that had lost its own (Iris, for example, which no longer received updates) gets it back.
⁠Opus can no longer take over another product’s update record.

note.item: ⁠Urgent fix, no new feature. Nothing to set again.

addition.item: ⁠New Weather element: the forecast for the place of your choice, from Open-Meteo, Météo-France or MET Norway.
⁠Map: service area in kilometres by road or as the crow flies, as well as driving time; the text of its three buttons can be set.
⁠Agenda: the text of its three buttons can be set, the title can be hidden, and article dates can repeat every year.
⁠Contact: “Labels” setting, and the email address is checked before saving.

change.item: ⁠A large module opens much faster: each element only brings the settings of its own type, and the class catalogue loads on demand.
⁠The “Move” handle answers the up and down arrow keys.
⁠A field filled in wrongly when saving: a window lists the fields to correct and leads to each one.

fix.item: ⁠Centred headings keep their rule centred under the text.
⁠The site search finds the text of blocks placed in an article (re-index once).

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. Nothing to set again.

fix.item: ⁠Works with the JCE editor: Opus took it for TinyMCE, the Joomla editor, and tried to drop its cards into it. That confusion could stop JCE from starting.
⁠Under JCE the “Opus: place a block” button works; block cards stay a TinyMCE feature.

addition.item: ⁠Opus becomes a package: the module and two plugins, installed and enabled on their own. Your modules and their settings stay as they are.
⁠New: place an Opus block inside an article. The editor button “Opus: place a block” opens a panel: Layout, Element, Reuse.
⁠In the article each block becomes a card: drag it, add a block above or below, edit it in a large window, preview it, remove it.
⁠The module list says which article each block is placed in.
⁠Map: service area by travel time or by kilometres. Cards: number of columns of your choice (automatic, 2, 3 or 4).
⁠Agenda: more readable dates, yearly events, looser date entry, declared to search engines.
⁠Texts and tables: a small bar with Bold, Italic, Link, List; paragraphs kept; simple formatting inside cells.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. A site still on Joomla 6.1 keeps its current version and is offered nothing that could break it.
